text_block_list.text:
One day, a while after the Twinkle Series 
had settled down for the time being.

I ended up going on the promised hot 
spring trip with Machikane Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Inn, inn, hot spring inn~ Hot spring 
inn-nnn♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer, want some snacks?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Candy, chocolate, gum, and... I bought all 
sorts of things within the 300 yen budget!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, because when it comes to snacks for 
a trip, they have to be under 300 yen, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I made up the last 10 yen with small 
pieces of gum and stuff, so yeah! This is 
the fruit of my hard work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And so, pick whatever you like! Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"A-And one more thing! Actually, I brought 
playing cards too! We absolutely have to 
play later, okay?"

Filled with a profound sense of nostalgia, 
I swayed on the train for a while...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...!? This is like 5 times more luxurious 
than the place I went on my school trip!?
We arrived safely at the inn.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm... dinner is at 18:00, right? Which 
means... um, free time now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean checking out souvenir 
shops, going to sightseeing spots, and 
stuff...? Hmmm.
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, wanna check out the hot 
springs first?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. There's no set bath time, is 
there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Umm, well then... let's get going!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that was so relaxing, refreshing, 
and bavanba-va-va-van.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fwaah~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Yeah, maybe it's 'cause I took a 
bath.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but don't worry! We came all this way, 
so we have to check out all kinds of 
places!
choice_data_list: Taking a nap is fine too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really? I see... So it's okay for me 
to sleep.
choice_data_list:
We came here to take it easy in the first 
place.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see. Whenever I think of a trip, I just 
picture everyone wandering around 
together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But as long as it's the two of us, it's 
fine. Fufu, this trip really feels so 
free...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*...

She must have really pushed herself, 
because Matikanetannhauser didn't wake up 
until the sun had completely set.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I overslept!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't all the tourist spots already 
closed by now?! Auuu, I totally messed 
up!"
choice_data_list:
On the plus side, it gave us time to 
relax, so it worked out.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, since we're here and all, I kinda 
wanted to make some memories.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Oh yeah. Wasn't there an ocean 
nearby?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, shall we go take a 
quick look?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waaa... So pretty! I can see so clearly 
even though it's nighttime!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"The breeze feels nice too. I'm so glad I 
came to see this..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Hot spring trips are so much 
fun~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, last night I was 
packing with the exact same excitement I 
felt on my school trips back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking we could buy snacks, bring 
a deck of cards, and visit a bunch of 
sightseeing spots."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I got way too excited and 
couldn't sleep much last night. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, a trip with just the two of us 
feels a little different from a school 
trip, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Free, fun, relaxed, with the usual 
everyday atmosphere, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So it's just a little special once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Our nap at the inn, and this nighttime 
sea... somehow, it all feels like a secret 
between just the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, just kidding. Said something 
weird, didn't I?

Matikanetannhauser smiled quietly as she 
watched the water lap against the shore 
and recede.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Let's go on a trip together again, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fuhe, yay~.

An irreplaceable bond with Machikane 
Tannhauser—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's past mealtime already!

"Despite everything that happened, it was 
a moment where I truly felt it..."
